title: glaucium corniculatum var. flavum
intro: Glaucium corniculatum var. flavum, commonly known as Yellow Hornpoppy, is a plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the exact mechanisms of action and bioactive constituents of Glaucium corniculatum var. flavum.
